gates.title: Dry-run has no Docker or NAS side effects
gates.evidence: This report reads local static deployment files only; it does not start Docker, workers, or NAS writes.

gates.title: NAS Docker compose static contract
gates.evidence: Static validator passed for deploy/nas/mixlab/docker-compose.yml and deploy/nas/mixlab/.env.example.

gates.title: Path isolation is explicit in compose
gates.evidence: Compose maps PUBLIC_LIBRARY_HOST_PATH into /data/PublicLibrary for runtime services; Mac /Volumes paths are not baked into Docker defaults.

gates.title: Admin image tag parity is statically declared
gates.evidence: admin-api, admin-worker, and admin-web use the same MIXLAB_IMAGE_TAG default contract.

gates.title: Admin container healthchecks are declared
gates.evidence: admin-api checks /health on 127.0.0.1:3889 and admin-web checks its internal HTTP root.

gates.title: Standalone worker flags default disabled
gates.evidence: MIXLAB_ENABLE_LIBRARY_PREPROCESS_WORKER and MIXLAB_ENABLE_READY_PUBLISH_WORKER default to 0 in compose and .env.example.

gates.title: admin-api and admin-worker are not host-published
gates.evidence: Static validation confirms only admin-web publishes a host port.

gates.title: Disk protection threshold is statically configured
gates.evidence: MIXLAB_PREPROCESS_DISK_BLOCK_USAGE_PERCENT defaults to 92 for admin-api and admin-worker.

gates.title: usage-events live tolerance and repair proof
gates.evidence: Static files cannot prove the target NAS events file is readable, tolerant of malformed rows, and repairable through the reviewed usage-events repair workflow.
gates.required_live_evidence: Run `npx tsx scripts/acceptance/usage-events-repair.ts --library-root <target>` as dry-run, archive the JSON/Markdown report, and only run `--apply` after separate reviewed maintenance approval.

gates.title: V001440 / stuck processing recovery proof
gates.evidence: Static files cannot prove the target stuck-job recovery path is safe for the current NAS state or that the deployed Admin API exposes the processing_recovery preflight contract.
gates.required_live_evidence: Run GET /api/admin/release-gates and verify processing_recovery, then archive GET /api/admin/preprocess/safety plus processing source-videos/jobs evidence before any separately reviewed recovery command.

gates.title: NAS disk space live protection proof
gates.evidence: The static disk threshold exists, but current NAS free space and write-block behavior must be checked on the target host.
gates.required_live_evidence: Capture target NAS disk availability and prove admin-api/admin-worker block unsafe preprocessing writes below the configured threshold.

gates.title: Live Docker health and version parity proof
gates.evidence: Static compose can declare images and healthchecks, but cannot prove the deployed containers run the intended tag and are healthy.
gates.required_live_evidence: After a separately approved deploy rehearsal, record admin-web/admin-api/admin-worker image tags, /health output, and version/build parity.

gates.title: Live admin-worker opt-in state proof
gates.evidence: Static defaults are disabled, but the target .env and running container environment still need live verification before upload/enablement.
gates.required_live_evidence: Capture the target Docker .env and running admin-worker environment showing standalone workers are disabled unless explicitly opted in.

gates.title: Cutter release/index/search compatibility proof
gates.evidence: Static Admin Docker checks cannot prove Windows Cutter continues reading the current release/index/search protocol.
gates.required_live_evidence: Run the Cutter compatibility smoke against the current release/index/search path after any Docker release candidate is staged.

result.summary: Docker upload remains blocked until required live NAS/Docker/Cutter proof is archived.
